note: Open: the bands call `new_domain_volume` only acceptable, because the domain is past its first 30 days. The call is that it is expected: at 38 days it sends 150,000 messages a week, its grade has dropped from medium to low and complaints are over 0.10%, so receivers are answering a warm-up that went faster than a domain with five weeks of history can carry. The warm-up is the cause to name, and passing day 30 did not end it; on a young domain whose grade and rates were holding, the bands' answer would stand. It rests on the warm-up advice in M3AAWG's sender best practices and, for the 0.10% line, on the bulk-sender requirements published by Google.
